holdings.thesis: HOLD: stop-loss flag deepened further to -45.6% (from -39.8% on 10/22) as the broader semiconductor/AI-infra selloff continued -- TIKR (updated 10/20) confirms CRDO fell 21.6% the week of 10/9-10/16 ($216.54->$169.70) on the sector-wide move; no CRDO-specific downgrade or announcement found 10/22-23. Fundamentals unchanged and strong (revenue +114.7% YoY, earnings +97.1% YoY). Reads as continued sector-beta pressure, not a fresh company-specific catalyst. Position ~5.1%.

HOLD: earnings-decline flag unchanged (-27.5% YoY, deliberate Max-tier sunset/AI-reinvestment). Dearborn Heights securities-fraud class action (W.D. Pa., No. 26-cv-02197) remains at the lead-plaintiff stage (deadline still 12/7/26) -- law-firm solicitations through ~10/12 just restate the existing 5/2/25-2/26/26 class-period allegations, no escalation found 10/22-23. Return +12.2%. Position ~11.6%.

Nov 5 AMC earnings date and 40%+ FY2026 revenue growth guidance (fundamentals: revenue +57.8%, earnings +105% YoY) remain unchanged. Position ~1.6%.

HOLD, watch continues: stop-loss flag essentially unchanged at -39.9% (from -39.5%), still tracking the broad semiconductor/AI-infra-adjacent selloff rather than a fresh VRT-specific catalyst -- no new news found 10/22-23. Fundamentals intact (revenue +24.1%, earnings +53% YoY). Oct 28 earnings date remains the key near-term catalyst; holding into the print. Position ~6.9%.

One source now lists Oct 28 as the earnings date (vs. previously-noted 'likely 10/29'), still not company-confirmed. Return -5.2%. Position ~15.1%.

HOLD: no new company-specific news found 10/22-23. Next earnings (fiscal Q1 2027) confirmed for Nov 5, 2026. Return +0.2%. Position ~6.1%.
HOLD: no new company-specific news found 10/22-23. Next earnings tentatively estimated ~Nov 5, not yet company-confirmed. Return +20.5%. Position ~5.1%.
HOLD: no new market-moving readout found 10/22-23. Oct 29 earnings date remains the key near-term catalyst. Return +9.8%. Position ~4.6%.

Va.) -- a June 29, 2026 notice remains the latest docket update, no ruling/lead-plaintiff appointment found (deadline was 7/27/26). Riley PT raise to $264, but it can't be dated to this window and is inconsistent with the stock's continued decline, so it isn't relied on as fresh news.
